turns.text: Hello, I received a print last week but the colors do not match my room. I would like to return it.
Hello, I am sorry the colors do not match your room. To check whether a return is possible, please send me your order number (SC- and four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
My order is SC-4060 and the email used is liam.fletcher.v2@example.com. Please file the return request.

Thank you, Liam. Your return request for order SC-4060 (Silent Horizons, 30x40 cm) has been filed as R-1 and is pending approval by our staff. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund, so please wait for their decision before sending the print back.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Separate question. How many working days does print production usually take?
Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

turns.text: Revin la printul meu. Cine plateste transportul pentru retur?

Conform regulii pentru printurile din catalog, clientul plătește transportul de retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă. Cererea ta de retur pentru comanda SC-4060 (R-1) este în așteptare până o aprobă personalul.
I still want to return order SC-4060. I can cover the return shipping.

Your return for order SC-4060 is already filed as R-1 and is waiting for staff approval, so I do not need to file it again. As the policy says, you cover the return postage. Staff will confirm the next steps, including the refund, once they review the request.
Mai am o intrebare pentru artista. As vrea sa ma programez pentru un tatuaj cu o frunza pe incheietura, de vreo 4 cm. Pot veni sambata dimineata.

Mulțumesc pentru detalii. Am notat: un tatuaj cu o frunză, pe încheietură, de aproximativ 4 cm, disponibil sâmbătă dimineața. Îți transmit cererea unui coleg, care va prelua conversația. Nu pot confirma prețul sau data.
